note: Changes made to scripts AFTER the frozen run. data/, schemas/ and results/receipts/ are untouched apart from the documented redaction.

patches.reason: run_sha256 is the hash the last run_eval.py invocation recorded in results/manifest.json (that version already carried the manifest fix: data/*.text.jsonl excluded from pinning). Since then the loader joins the rehydration sidecar by id, checks every text against its hash, and preflights every requested task before the first paid call; the shipped rerun could not run the seven redacted tasks. No measurement changed.

balanced() reset the index before the top-up, so df.drop(out.index) removed the wrong source rows and the refill could draw a row already chosen. Fixed to drop by original index and assert uniqueness. The frozen samples were built with the old code: 7 offensive rows and 1 emotion row repeat an earlier text. No frozen file or receipt changed. Exact duplicate texts are now collapsed before any draw.

Extended to recompute Wilson intervals, McNemar, latency percentiles, costs, confidence gates, ECE and reliability bins, p_chosen gates and their cross-validation, the per-class error profile, the TF-IDF and current-model columns and the cost curve from the receipts. Previously it only recounted accuracy. No measurement changed. Now also re-reads every raw response and requires the stored prediction, confidence and model to match it, checks that each arm answers every sample id exactly once, and counts out-of-schema labels.
